title: コンピュータシステム基礎
subtitle: Foundations of Computer Systems
keywords: Binary Encoding 2.Arithmetic Logic Unit 3.CPU 4.Machine Code 5.Assembly Language
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn how to store information as “binary data” on computer systems. (2) Learn the basic mechanism of processing “machine code” inside computer systems. (3) Acquire skills to program in “machine code” using an assembly language.
advice: This is a basic course for understanding computer architecture and utilizing it for programming. We will cover the following materials: 1. Basic computer configuration 2. Binary encoding 3. Boolean expression 4. Logic circuit basics 5. Arithmetic logic unit 6. Memory configuration 7. Instruction cycle 8. Machine code 9. Addressing mode 10. Assembly languages 11. Programming techniques in assembly languages Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class/on a regular

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the information encoding, and basic features of computer systems.
Be able to derive Boolean expressions from truth tables.
Be able to explain the addressing mode.
Be able to explain the instruction cycle.
Be able to explain the conditional branch instruction, and create programs utilizing it.
Be able to trace the program execution process.

lessons.content: Basic Computer Configuration 1 Understand overview of the computer configuration consisting of CPU and memory.
Basic Computer Configuration 2 Learn the two's complement (radix complements) and hexadecimal.
lessons.assignments: Review (overview of the computer configuration) Preparation (Chapter 4 of textbook 1)

lessons.content: Basic Computer Configuration 3 Learn fixed-point arithmetic and floating-point arithmetic in computing.
lessons.assignments: Review (two's complement and hexadecimal) Preparation (Chapter 5 of textbook 1)

lessons.content: Basic Computer Configuration 4 Learn truth tables, Boolean expression, and logic gates.
lessons.assignments: Review (fixed-point arithmetic and floating-point arithmetic) Preparation (Chapter 5 of textbook 1)

lessons.content: Basic Computer Configuration 5 Learn the logic circuit and ALU basics (half adder, full adder, and 8-bit adder).
lessons.assignments: Review (truth tables, Boolean expression, and logic gates) Preparation (Chapter 5 of textbook 1)

lessons.content: Basic Computer Configuration 6 Learn the memory configuration, instruction cycle, and machine code.
lessons.assignments: Review (logic circuit and ALU basics) Preparation (Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 1 Learn overview of assembly language CASL 2/COMET 2.
lessons.assignments: Review (Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 of textbook 2) Preparation (Chapter 3 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 2 Learn addressing mode on CASL 2/COMET 2.
lessons.assignments: Review (Chapter 3 of textbook 2) Preparation (Chapter 4 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 3 Learn moves-instruction on CASL 2/COMET 2.
lessons.assignments: Review (Chapter 4 of textbook 2) Preparation (Chapter 5 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 4 Learn arithmetic instructions and logic operations on CASL 2/COMET 2.
lessons.assignments: Review (Chapter 5 of textbook 2) Preparation (Chapter 6 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 5 Learn branch instructions and conditions on CASL 2/COMET 2
lessons.assignments: Review (Chapter 6 of textbook 2) Preparation (Chapter 7 of textbook 2)

lessons.content: Machine Code Programming 6 Learn stack operations and subroutine on CASL 2/COMET 2.
Integrated learning Learn various programming techniques.
